items.intro_words: Well, welcome everyone. Let's see if you require Spanish interpretation

And now we have our bond program action item. Welcome. Will Robertson.
Okay, on to discussion items. So 9.1, spring expansion of the school district, January reopening.
So we are on to 9.1 B, which is the vision and mission. And this is a carryover from our six o' clock study session.
If we get any updates, we'll certainly be sending them out. And I imagine, Dr. Baker, you'll be reminding everybody about this in your Friday email.
All right, so we're on to consent items. Do I have a motion to approve?
All right, so we're on to the report from board members and superintendent. Who would like to go first?
So information, we had a couple items there. We had the San Mateo county first interim financial and budget overview.
Correspondence. I know we've gotten a lot of emails about reopening questions.
All right. Other business suggested items for future agenda, vision and mission and values will be on that at some point.
Motion to approve. So moved. You all like this so much. We're gonna stay all night.
